about.title: Professional Profile
about.description: Full-stack developer from Morocco specializing in modern web application development. I combine clean code practices with creative problem-solving to deliver solutions that users love. Passionate about performance optimization, accessibility, and building products that make an impact.

experiences.description: Managed and maintained internal IT systems and network infrastructure to ensure stability and availability. Provided first and second-level technical support, resolving critical hardware, software, and network issues rapidly to minimize operational downtime. Streamlined support processes through documentation, reducing average resolution time.

Designed, developed, and launched 8+ custom, performance-focused websites using Next.js and React. Implemented responsive, high-fidelity UIs with **Tailwind CSS**. Applied rigorous technical standards to deliver maintainable, scalable, and high-quality codebases while providing technical consulting to clients.

Built a comprehensive e-commerce management dashboard using **React.js**. Streamlined the UI with Tailwind CSS & Bootstrap, cutting page load times by 40%. Secured crucial API communications via **Axios with JWT authentication** and designed data visualizations using **ECharts**.

Developed a critical web application to automate the management of association and cooperative files using a **React.js** frontend and **Node.js** backend. Digitized the entire file process, significantly improving administrative efficiency and implementing advanced features like data filtering and authorization.
